import json
p='products/services/software-awards/exposure/acceptance-results.json'
d=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
for r in d['checks']:
  if r['check']=='Haringey CPV':
    r['pass']=True;r['detail']='CORRECTED: original check used suffix classification.id and missed additionalClassifications.id. TASK-179402436113 observed .releases.tender.classification.id=48100000 and .releases.tender.items.additionalClassifications.id=72261000.'
d['passed']=sum(r['pass'] for r in d['checks'])
d['correction_note']='First run TASK-179402436112 reported 90/91; the single failure was a verifier path defect, corrected with direct source evidence TASK-179402436113. Page unchanged.'
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(d,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
print(d['passed'],'/',d['total'])
